title: Associate III - BPM Product Configuration QA Analyst
description:
**Role description** **BPM Product Configuration QA Analyst**

**Role Summary**

The Product Configuration QA Analyst is responsible for independently validating product and group configurations in TriZetto Facets to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with approved business requirements. The role performs quality audits, configuration testing, defect analysis, and root cause investigations while supporting defect prevention and continuous quality improvement.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Validation**

* Review configured products, groups, accounts, and benefit plans against source documentation.


* Validate configuration accuracy across benefit structures, eligibility rules, accumulators, provider networks, and plan attributes.


* Ensure TriZetto Facets configurations align with contract requirements and approved business rules.


* Conduct comprehensive quality reviews before production deployment. Testing Activities


* Execute configuration validation testing in TriZetto Facets.


* Perform end\-to\-end testing of benefit and group configurations.


* Validate downstream impacts on enrollment, claims, and member servicing processes.


* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and production verification activities.


**Defect Analysis \& Root Cause Analysis**

* Identify configuration defects and quality gaps.


* Classify and trend configuration errors.


* Conduct root cause analysis across people, process, and system dimensions.


* Recommend corrective and preventive actions.



**Calibration \& Reporting**


* Participate in quality calibration sessions.


* Maintain audit scorecards and quality reporting metrics.


* Analyze defect trends and quality performance indicators.


* Provide actionable recommendations to configuration leadership.


**Compliance \& Governance**

* Ensure adherence to configuration standards and procedures.


* Support audit readiness and documentation requirements.


* Validate compliance with regulatory and contractual obligations.



**Mandatory Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of healthcare payer product and group configuration in TriZetto Facets.


* Experience reviewing benefit plans and group setup documents.


* Strong analytical, testing, and auditing skills.


* Ability to identify defects and perform root cause analysis.


* Excellent documentation and reporting capabilities.


**Qualifications Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.


**Experience**

* 5\+ years of healthcare payer configuration experience.


* Minimum 2\+ years performing configuration QA or audit functions.


* Experience validating benefit and group configurations.


**Required Platform**

* Hands\-on experience testing and validating product, benefit, and group configuration in TriZetto Facets.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


* Audit accuracy rate


* Defect identification rate


* Defect leakage rate


* First\-pass quality


* Audit completion turnaround time


* Calibration consistency score


* RCA completion effectiveness

 **Skills**  

FACETS, Claims Management, Healthcare Plan Configuration

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: Security Detection Engineer
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands.**


**We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**  

  

**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100\+ markets, with deep local expertise.**  

  

**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**  

  

**For more information, visit** **WPP.com.**

  


**Why we're hiring:**



Detection Engineering is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high\-fidelity detection logic across enterprise security platforms. This role focuses on proactive threat detection, automation\-first practices, and continuous improvement of detection coverage and accuracy, supporting the WPP SOC transformation into an Autonomic Security Operations model.


**What you'll be doing:**


* Develop, test, and maintain detection rules and logic across SIEM, EDR, NDR, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Regularly review and enhance detection logic to improve accuracy, reduce noise, and align with evolving threats.
* Work with wider WPP engineering teams to ensure high\-quality, normalized telemetry for effective detection.
* Automate detection rule deployment, QA, and version control using scripting and CI/CD pipelines.


**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**


* Conduct RCA on missed detections, delayed responses, and high\-severity incidents.
* Identify technical and process\-level causes of detection failures or inefficiencies.
* Drive corrective actions based on RCA outcomes (e.g., rule improvements, visibility gaps).
* Continuous Security Improvement (CSI)
* Maintain a CSI backlog (detection gaps, telemetry blind spots, false positives to reduce).
* Analyze detection performance metrics to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
* Align detection priorities with business risk and the SOC transformation roadmap.
* Cross\-Team Collaboration
* Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, and Threat Hunting teams to operationalize detection improvements.
* Work with Threat Intelligence teams to integrate emerging TTPs into detection logic.
* Contribute to purple team exercises by validating detection logic against simulated attack paths.


**Strategic Alignment to GCAT SOC10x**


* 10X People: Continuous learning and knowledge sharing within the team.
* 10X Process: Embed agile workflows and automation\-first principles.
* 10X Technology: Leverage AI/ML for detection tuning and anomaly detectio.
* 10X Visibility: Ensure comprehensive telemetry ingestion and observability.
* 10X Speed: Reduce detection\-to\-response cycle through orchestration and automation.


**What you'll need:**


**Technical Expertise**


* Strong knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud security platforms.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell).
* Familiarity with detection\-as\-code principles and CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of MITRE ATT\&CK framework and threat\-informed defense.


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Ability to work closely with SOC analysts, threat hunters, and engineers.
* Skilled in documenting detection logic and RCA outcomes.


**Certifications (Preferred)**


* GIAC GCTI, GCFA, or equivalent advanced security certifications.


**Key Attributes**


* Automation\-first mindset with focus on scalability and resilience.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork capabilities.


**Who you are:**


**You're open*****:***we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open\-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.


**You're optimistic*****:*** we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.


**You're extraordinary:** We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.


**What we'll give you:**


**Passionate, inspired people** – we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work


**Scale and opportunity** – we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.


**Challenging and stimulating work** – unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.

  



\#LI\-Hybrid

**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**

title: Automation Tester - Banking Domain
description:
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced **Automation Tester** with strong expertise in **test automation and banking/financial services applications**. The candidate should be able to work independently in a fast\-paced environment and join **immediately or within a short notice period**.


Key Responsibilities* Design, develop and maintain automated test scripts for banking applications.
* Prepare and execute **test scenarios, test cases, regression and integration testing**.
* Automate functional, regression and end\-to\-end testing using appropriate automation frameworks.
* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into effective test cases.
* Perform **API testing** and validate backend/database data.
* Identify, document, track and validate defects through closure.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, Developers and other QA teams.
* Participate in **SIT, UAT and production validation** activities.
* Ensure test coverage, quality standards and timely delivery.
* Support continuous improvement of automation frameworks and testing processes.


Required Skills* **10 years of experience in Software Testing / QA Automation.**
* Strong **Banking / Financial Services domain experience** is mandatory.
* Hands\-on experience with **Selenium / Java / Python** or similar automation tools.
* Experience in **API testing** using tools such as Postman / REST Assured.
* Strong knowledge of **SQL and database testing**.
* Experience with **TestNG / JUnit, Maven** and automation frameworks.
* Good understanding of **Agile / Scrum methodology**.
* Experience with **JIRA, Git and CI/CD tools** will be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, defect management and test methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, communication and problem\-solving skills.


Candidate Preference* **10 years overall QA/Automation experience**
* **Banking domain experience is mandatory**
* **Immediate joiner / candidates serving short notice preferred**
* Candidates who can join immediately will be given priority.

title: Software Testing Engineer
description:
**Software Tester**

**Experience**: 2–5\+ years

**Employment Type**: Full\-time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Software Tester / QA Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of software applications through comprehensive testing and defect management.

The candidate should have strong experience in manual testing, with exposure to automation testing, API testing, database testing, and Agile methodologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

Analyze business and technical requirements and prepare detailed test scenarios and test cases.

Perform functional, regression, integration, system, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing.

Identify, document, track, and verify software defects using defect\-tracking tools.

Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, product managers, and other QA team members.

Execute test cases and maintain accurate test execution and defect reports.

Participate in requirement reviews and provide feedback from a testing and quality perspective.

Perform API testing using tools such as Postman or similar platforms.

Perform basic database testing and SQL queries to validate backend data.

Contribute to automation testing using tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar technologies, where applicable.

Analyze test failures and work with development teams to identify root causes.

Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

Ensure testing activities are completed within project timelines and quality standards.

Continuously improve testing processes, documentation, and overall product quality.

**Required Skills**

2–5\+ years of hands\-on experience in software testing/QA.

Strong knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and defect life cycle.

Good understanding of SDLC and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Strong experience in writing and executing test cases.

Good knowledge of functional and regression testing.

Experience with defect management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.

Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman.

Good understanding of SQL and database validation.

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

Good communication and documentation skills.

Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

Pay: ₹339,924\.92 \- ₹1,554,651\.57 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
